content:
maya: hey team — customer 'Acme Corp' sees intermittent parse failures when using streaming JSON mode + pydantic validation hook. Repro below. They get pydantic.ValidationError on chunk boundary.

support-bot: ticket created  #INC-8742 — assigned to support

alex: can you paste the raw stream that causes the failure? is this only with validation enabled?

maya: yup only when validation_hook=True. here's a snippet from the stream they forwarded:
```
{ "id": 1, "items": ["a", "b"
{ "id": 2, "items": ["c", "d"] }
```
This results in JSONDecodeError / then pydantic raises ValidationError: Expecting value: line 1 column 22 (char 21)

ryan: looks like chunks are being joined incorrectly — missing comma/closing bracket between chunks. Is the client using newline-delimited JSON or a single JSON object streamed? What's the stream mode param?

maya: client uses mode=stream_json (single object). They rely on us to emit a complete JSON object across chunks. Repro request:
```
curl -v POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"xlarge","stream":true,"json_mode":true,"validation_hook":"pydantic"}'
```

ryan: ok can you capture full raw bytes? need to see chunk boundaries. Potential causes: 1) runtime applies sanitization that drops a comma when a prefix cache flushes; 2) validation hook eagerly parses partial payloads. Quick workaround: set validation_hook to 'deferred' (validate after stream complete) or client can buffer until final chunk. We'll add a patch to make validation hooks opt-in for streaming.

eng-runtime-bot: created issue ENG-1345: 'deferred-validate-streams' assigned to eng-runtime

deploy-bot: escalation created: support#INC-8742 -> ENG-1345

maya: thanks — forwarding workaround to customer (defer validation client-side). i'll attach raw capture when they send it. :thumbsup:
